headlines.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general after weeks of uncertainty
headlines.description: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as U.S. attorney general early Saturday in a mostly party-line vote, capping off weeks of uncertainty and despite bipartisan concerns about his ability to run a Justice Department independent of President Donald Trump’s impulses.

headlines.title: Progressives win in Michigan, and a pop star announces a break: The news quiz
headlines.description: A rocket collides with the moon, restaurants grapple with salmonella, and the CDC finally has a permanent leader.

headlines.title: Iran says deal on Strait of Hormuz is close but will not open the waterway by itself
headlines.description: Iran said on Saturday that a deal with Oman on control of the Strait of Hormuz was close but would not be enough to free up the waterway, and the United Arab Emirates said Iran had hit another ship there.

headlines.title: DATELINE FRIDAY SNEAK PEEK: Suspicion in Silver City
headlines.description: When the mysterious death of a 23-year-old mother in New Mexico goes unsolved, her family searches for answers. Keith Morrison reports, Friday, August 7 at 10/9c on NBC.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands without water in Puerto Rico
headlines.description: Families and businesses in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and nearby towns now have to make do with whatever water they have on hand amid rolling shutoffs that last for 48 hours at a time. NBC News' George Solis is on the ground.

headlines.title: Video shows hippo charging boat full of tourists in Botswana
headlines.description: Video captured by a tourist aboard a boat in northern Botswana showed the heart-pounding moment the vessel had to outrun a charging hippo.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Senate passes short-term bill to prevent a shutdown before the midterm elections
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted 90-6 early Saturday to pass a short-term funding bill to remove the threat of a government shutdown before the midterm elections.
